input.quote: Garman hereby grants to Sparkling, for the use of Sparkling and affiliated companies of Sparkling operating at Authorized Locations, a non-transferable and non-exclusive licence to use: (i) the Software, safely in executable object code format, at each AS400 at each of the Authorized Locations; and (ii) the Documentation.
input.rationale: The grant is perpetual (Section 17(a): in effect perpetually while fees are paid) and not revocable at Garman's discretion, and it already extends to Sparkling's affiliated companies, so it is not walk-away territory. However it fails the fallback on two material terms: it is expressly "non-transferable" with assignment barred without Garman's consent (Sections 3(c) and 20(d)), leaving no right to transfer the licence to a successor in an M&A transaction; and contractors or outsourced providers using the Software on our behalf are not covered, with any sublicence available only at Garman's discretion. The redline makes the minimal edits to reach the preferred position: contractor use on our behalf at the Authorized Locations, and assignment of the agreement and licence to a successor on a merger or sale of the business, while preserving Garman's consent right for all other assignments and the Authorized Locations limits.

proposal.summary: Extend licence to contractors acting on our behalf and permit transfer of the licence to a successor in an M&A transaction.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have extended the licence to contractors and outsourced providers using the Software on our behalf, and allowed the licence to move with the business to a successor in a merger or sale, consistent with our licence-scope position. The licence remains restricted to the Authorized Locations and Garman's consent right is preserved for all other assignments.

ops.oldText: for the use of Sparkling and affiliated companies of Sparkling operating at Authorized Locations
ops.newText: for the use of Sparkling, affiliated companies of Sparkling and contractors and outsourced service providers acting on behalf of Sparkling or such affiliated companies, in each case operating at Authorized Locations

ops.oldText: except as and when authorized to do so by Garman in writing
ops.newText: except as permitted by Section 20(d) or as and when authorized to do so by Garman in writing

ops.oldText: Neither party may assign this Agreement or any rights and obligations under this Agreement to any third party without the written consent of the other party.
ops.newText: Neither party may assign this Agreement or any rights and obligations under this Agreement to any third party without the written consent of the other party, except that either party may assign this Agreement, including the licence granted under Section 2, to a successor in connection with a merger, amalgamation, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets or business without such consent.
